tasks.short: Teach proper breathing techniques during physical exertion.

steps.what: Watch how this participant breathes during the physical exertion.
outputs: what the instructor saw in the breathing

steps.what: Teach proper breathing techniques for that physical exertion.
inputs: what the instructor saw in the breathing
outputs: the breathing technique shown to this participant

tasks.design: The instructor watches this participant during the exertion and teaches the breathing technique in the room. No card, no model, and no recording stands in for that watch or that teaching.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cue depends on how this person is breathing in this exertion, which is visible only in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new is required. The instructor already teaches this by watching and showing.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing a held breath or a rushed breath, and showing the change while the person is exerting, stays with the instructor.
tasks.human_edge: Matching the cue to the breath they can see and hear in this person, in this exertion.
tasks.altitude: The week does not change. The instructor still watches every participant and still teaches the breathing technique in the room.

reach.task: Try the breathing technique during the exertion
reach.learn: To say when the cue does not match how the exertion feels

evidence.claim: Teaching a breathing technique during exertion is watching the person and showing the cue. A note cannot see the breath. Model knowledge.
An app that time-stamps each correction can monitor how the instructor works. National works-council rules require consent for that. This task adds no such app.

assumptions: The boundary is one participant and one exertion in the room. Watching and teaching each keep their full time.
There is no structured input and no machine action. Nothing sends a cue, raises an alert, or fills a form.
The instructor adds no recurring chore. Upkeep on this task is zero.
unknowns: Whether the centre already has a written breathing cue the instructor ignores because the live breath matters more.
research_questions: How often is the cue a standard count for this class, and how often does it change because of what the instructor sees in this person?

incremental.description: The instructor adds no recurring chore. Watching and teaching stay the whole task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Watching the breath and teaching the technique both stay in the room at full time. There is no lookup to shorten.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide nutrition, weight and lifestyle information and resources.

steps.what: Read the centre notes on nutrition, weight control and lifestyle issues for this student.
inputs: resource card when the health officer has written one
outputs: the nutrition, weight and lifestyle notes that apply

steps.what: Provide students with information and resources on those nutrition, weight control and lifestyle issues.
inputs: the nutrition, weight and lifestyle notes that apply
outputs: what the instructor told this student

tasks.design: The health officer keeps a resource card: topic, title, who it is for, source, and date. The instructor reads that card, or the leaflet when a row is missing, then tells the student which information and resources fit. The telling stays in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: Leaflets on nutrition, weight and lifestyle sat in a folder, so each question started as a search.
tasks.enabler_now: The health officer already holds those leaflets. Writing the current ones on a card needs no new system and no model.
tasks.still_hard: Saying what fits this student, and refusing a claim the card does not support, stays with the instructor.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing what to tell this student, and stopping when the question is medical rather than a centre leaflet.
tasks.altitude: Finding a current leaflet is shorter when the card is dated. The instructor still decides what fits and still tells the student.

reach.task: Keep the nutrition, weight and lifestyle resource card
reach.learn: To date each row, name its source, and remove a leaflet the centre no longer uses

evidence.claim: An instructor can hand a student a centre leaflet on nutrition, weight or lifestyle and explain which part fits. A card shortens finding the leaflet. It does not give the advice. Model knowledge.
Weight and health details can be special-category data. The instructor does not paste them into a general tool and does not record the conversation. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The boundary is one student and one question. Telling the student keeps its full time.

Resource card fields are topic, title, who it is for, source, and date. The producer is the health officer, when a leaflet changes. If a row is missing or stale, the instructor reads the leaflet inside the lookup.
The card does not write the advice, send a message, or raise an alert. The instructor does not record the student's weight.
Card upkeep is the health officer's 1.5 hours per 100 instructor hours on this task. The instructor's own upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether the centre has a health officer, or the instructor is the only person who holds the leaflets.
Which questions the centre treats as medical and therefore out of this task.
research_questions: Of the nutrition, weight and lifestyle questions on this desk, how many are answered by a current leaflet, and how many need a judgement the leaflet does not cover?

incremental.description: The instructor adds no recurring chore. Reading the card is the lookup step.
The health officer updates the resource card when a leaflet, its source, or its date changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the card has no current row, the instructor reads the leaflet inside the lookup. Telling the student what fits stays at full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain equipment inventories and select, store or issue equipment.

steps.what: Count the equipment on hand before the inventories are written.
Maintain the equipment inventories by writing the quantity on hand.
inputs: item card when the facilities keeper has written one
outputs: the equipment inventory line just written

steps.what: Select and store the equipment this class will not use.
inputs: the equipment inventory line just written

steps.what: Issue that equipment to the participants as needed.

tasks.design: The facilities keeper keeps an item card: item name and store place. The instructor counts the equipment, writes only the quantity on that line, or writes the item name too when the line is missing, then selects what to store and issues the rest. The instructor writes the quantity by hand.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each count started by rewriting the item name and the store place before the quantity.
tasks.enabler_now: The facilities keeper already knows the item names and where they are kept. A paper line needs no new system.
tasks.still_hard: Counting what is in the room, choosing what this class needs, storing the rest, and handing pieces out stay physical work.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing what is actually in the studio, and choosing what this class can use safely.
tasks.altitude: Writing a known item name is shorter when the line exists. The instructor still counts, still writes the quantity, still stores, and still issues.

reach.task: Keep the item name and store place on the equipment card
reach.learn: To add a line when a new piece arrives and to strike a line when a piece is retired

evidence.claim: An equipment count is a person in the room. A pre-written item line shortens only the writing of the name, not the count, the storing, or the issue. Model knowledge.
An app that time-stamps each issue can monitor how the instructor works. National works-council rules require consent for that. This task adds no such app.

assumptions: The boundary is one studio and one class. Counting, selecting, storing, and issuing each keep their full time.

Item card fields are item name and store place. The producer is the facilities keeper, when a piece arrives or is retired. If a line is missing, the instructor writes the item name inside the inventory step, after the count.
The instructor writes the quantity by hand on that line. Nothing fills the line, sends the count, or raises an alert.
Card upkeep is the facilities keeper's 1.5 hours per 100 instructor hours on this task. The instructor's own upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether the centre has a facilities keeper, or the instructor maintains the item names alone.
How often a piece is in the room but not on the card.
research_questions: Of the inventory lines written here, how many are a quantity on an existing item name, and how many are a new item the instructor must name?

incremental.description: The instructor adds no recurring chore. Writing the quantity is the inventory step.
The facilities keeper adds or strikes an item line when a piece arrives or is retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the item line is missing, the instructor writes the name as well as the quantity. Counting, storing, and issuing stay at full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise clients about proper clothing and shoes.

steps.what: Read the clothing and shoe note for this activity before advising.
inputs: clothing card when the lead instructor has written one
outputs: the clothing and shoe note that applies

steps.what: Advise clients about the proper clothing and shoes for this activity.
inputs: the clothing and shoe note that applies
outputs: the clothing and shoe advice given

tasks.design: The lead instructor keeps a clothing card: activity, clothing, shoe type, and the reason. The instructor reads that card, or the class note when a row is missing, then advises the client from what they are wearing. The advice stays in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: The clothing and shoe note for each activity sat in the class plan, so each client started as a search.
tasks.enabler_now: The lead instructor already sets those notes. Writing them once on a card needs no new system and no model.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing what this client is wearing, and saying what to change for this activity, stays with the instructor.
tasks.human_edge: Looking at this client's clothing and shoes and saying the change that fits this activity.
tasks.altitude: Finding the activity note is shorter when the card is current. The instructor still looks at the client and still gives the advice.

reach.task: Keep the clothing and shoe note for each activity
reach.learn: To name the activity, the clothing, the shoe type, and the reason, and to change the row when the activity changes

evidence.claim: Advice on clothing and shoes is looking at the client and the activity. A short activity note can shorten the search for the centre's rule. It does not give the advice. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The boundary is one client and one activity. Advising keeps its full time.

Clothing card fields are activity, clothing, shoe type, and reason. The producer is the lead instructor, when an activity changes. If a row is missing, the instructor reads the class note inside the lookup.
The card does not advise the client, send a message, or raise an alert.
Card upkeep is the lead instructor's 1 hour per 100 instructor hours on this task. The instructor's own upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether a lead instructor keeps activity notes, or each instructor holds their own.
How often the advice turns on an injury or a medical need the card does not cover.
research_questions: Of the clothing and shoe conversations here, how many follow a written activity note, and how many turn on what the client is wearing that day?

incremental.description: The instructor adds no recurring chore. Reading the card is the lookup step.
The lead instructor updates the clothing card when an activity, a clothing rule, or a shoe rule changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the activity has no card row, the instructor reads the class note inside the lookup. Advising the client stays at full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The instructor still watches and teaches breathing in the room, still tells the student what fits, still counts, stores and issues equipment, and still advises on clothing and shoes. A current card only shortens finding a leaflet, an item name, or an activity note.
reach: A health officer learns to date each nutrition, weight and lifestyle row and name its source before the instructor tells a student.
A facilities keeper learns to keep item name and store place on the equipment card before the instructor writes a quantity.
A lead instructor learns to name activity, clothing, shoe type and reason before a client is advised.
skills_to_grow: Open the leaflet, the class note, or a blank item line when the card has no row.
Write the quantity they counted, and do not copy a quantity they did not count.
Tell the student only a dated note, and say when the question is outside that note.
role.ambitious_version: The instructor still teaches, advises, counts and issues. The cards do not teach, advise, count, or issue.
